summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of the NEW nested sub-folder feature. Validated all 12 flows end-to-end on the public URL. 11/12 passed. Only failure: folder collapse/expand has an off-by-one state bug where the FIRST click on folder-toggle does NOT collapse the folder (the folder stays open on the first click, then collapses on the second click). Everything else works: root folder create, rename, sub-folder create, deep nesting (3 levels), notes in sub-folder, recursive item count on parent (counts all descendant notes), recursive delete with notes moved to unorganized, search (incl. Ctrl+K), dark mode, Pages section for unorganized notes.

ui_bugs.issue: First click on folder-toggle does nothing visible. Requires 2 clicks to collapse an already-open folder. Root cause: initial state `expanded[folder.id]` is undefined, `isOpen = expanded[id] !== false` → true. The toggle does `!p[id]` which is `!undefined = true`, leaving isOpen still true. After that 2nd click toggles it to false and collapse works. Fix: initialize expanded state for newly rendered folders to true, OR change toggle to `expanded[id] === false ? true : false` / `expanded[id] !== true`.

action_items:
FIX (MEDIUM): In components/Sidebar.jsx, fix the toggle logic so the FIRST click on folder-toggle collapses an already-open folder. Two simple options:
  (a) Change `toggle` to: `setExpanded((p) => ({ ...p, [folder.id]: p[folder.id] === false }))` (reads like: if currently collapsed → open; otherwise collapse). Pair with `isOpen = expanded[folder.id] !== false` unchanged.
  (b) Or flip the default: initialize expanded entries to `true` when the folder is first rendered (useEffect) and use `isOpen = expanded[id] === true`.

rca of the issue:
Folder collapse bug RCA:
  Reproduction: 1) Create a root folder. 2) Click folder-add-subfolder to create a nested child (root auto-stays open). 3) Click folder-toggle-{rootId} once → child still visible (BUG). 4) Click again → now collapsed. 5) Click again → expanded.
  Root cause: In Sidebar.jsx, `const isOpen = expanded[folder.id] !== false;` treats undefined as open. The `toggle` callback does `[id]: !p[id]` which turns `undefined` into `true` (stays open per isOpen), not `false` (which would collapse). So the first click only sets expanded=true explicitly, leaving isOpen true.
  Mitigation (tested logic): Replace toggle with `setExpanded(p => ({ ...p, [id]: p[id] === false }))`. Then first click on a default-open folder sets it to false (collapsed), second sets to true (expanded). Works with existing `isOpen = expanded[id] !== false`.
  Verified via 3 sequential clicks on the toggle: visible=true, true, false, true → confirms bug.
